title: xDrip+ does not vibrate when phone is on silent mode, but alert is set to override silent.
body: I sometimes put xDrip into vibrate only or Ascending volume, and neither vibrate when the phone is on silent mode. Putting the profile in Low, Medium, or High, works properly and the phone makes the sound even in silent mode, however, they do not vibrate.

comments.body: What version of android does your phone run? Is it a silent audio profile on the phone or is it the android 6+ "do not disturb" feature you are using?

My phone is a Nexus 6p running 7.1.  It is the Do Not Disturb feature. I
have noticed the alarms come in over the general audio stream, perhaps it
should come over as notification and could be tagged as priority?

Ok, I have tested in do-not-disturb mode, (total silence/alarms only) and the alert plays fine for me. This is on a Sony Android 6.0 phone. I will try to see if I can reproduce this in the emulator on 7.x upwards.

Testing on the Android 8.0 emulator. The "override silent mode" option in the xDrip alarm setting appears to work fine in `Priority Only` and `Alarms Only` Android do-not-disturb modes. The only one it doesn't work in is `Total Silence`. Are you seeing something different?

I tested this by setting the Alarm profile to medium in xDrip settings and using the `Test Alert`  feature in the Alert edit window.
